# HexPiece 2.5.8

Two first-person fixes from your screenshot and report. Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks pass. Everything
from 2.5.7 is in here too.

## The sword in first person with an empty hand
- **What was wrong:** you can fight with your hand empty (the katana stays at your hip). But the first-person sword view (the hand
  on the hilt, the draw, the blade in your hand, the sheathing) only worked while you held the katana itself in your hand. With an
  empty hand you saw your plain arm through everything.
- **Now:** with an empty hand, as a Swordsman in combat mode, your left hand rests on the hilt and your right hand stays free (it
  still punches and digs). The draw, the blade between cuts and the sheathing all show, the same as when holding the katana.
- Out of combat mode, or in another fighting style, your empty hand is the normal one.

## The invisible arm with Haki on
- **What was wrong:** with Armament or Ryou on, the first-person arm vanished and only the purple aura's outline was left. The
  original mod replaces your arm with a black-coated one, but HexPiece blackens your hands in the skin instead, and nothing was drawing
  the arm itself any more.
- **Now:** your arm is drawn with its blackened hand, and the aura and glow sit on it again. The arms in the sword's first-person
  view (drawing, holding, sheathing) get the same Haki coat and aura.

## Please test
- Empty hand, Swordsman, combat mode: the hand on the hilt, then draw (attack), cut, wait for the sheathing.
- Haki on with an empty hand: your arm should be there, with its aura.
- Gryphon and Yoru draw by themselves the moment you enter combat mode; the katanas stay sheathed until your first cut or charge.
  If that's the difference you meant by "some swords have it, some don't", tell me how you want the katanas to draw.
